architecture.title: A live voice session with Jev as the referee
architecture.caption: The live model talks to the caller in real time. After every turn its transcripts (heard + said) go to Jev with the hotel facts; five typed checks come back in ~0.4 s, and a per-call state machine in code proposes the real actions: page the on-call, speak the safety line, correct a promise or an invented fact, hand off to a human. The live model never dispatches anyone.

sequence.title: Lab 14-4 turn 2 — smoke, measured live
sequence.caption: gemini-3.8-live, naive prompt. The caller's transcript arrives together with the model's first word (9.25 s), so Jev cannot pre-empt that word; its verdict is ready 0.37 s later (365 ms), still inside the turn, so code barges in with the approved line and pages the real on-call.
